static_traits.name: Lin Wei
static_traits.social_status: Difficulty with interpersonal interaction, struggling to build and maintain friendships; has a supportive Mother but is unwilling to discuss Social anxiety with her
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no history of psychotherapy or counseling
static_traits.language_features: Positive attitude, highly cooperative; can clearly describe social situations, automatic thoughts, and emotional experiences; willing to try strategies such as small goals and breathing relaxation

basic_info.main_problem: I feel I have no friends because I do not know how to talk to anyone, which leads to isolation and a sense of Loneliness.
basic_info.core_demands: Because isolation and Loneliness are beginning to affect mental health and overall well-being, hoping to improve social interaction through counseling, reduce avoidance, and gradually build social connections and friendships.
growth_experiences: Since High school has continuously experienced isolation and Loneliness, believing oneself unable to talk with others; feeling Anxiety in group settings, often freezing and avoiding socializing; although having tried to initiate conversations, not yet succeeded, and not yet sought professional help; these patterns continue to this day, affecting daily motivation and Interpersonal relationships.

core_beliefs: I am clumsy and not good at socializing
I am not liked / others will not like me

special_situations.event: At a small gathering of family and friends, everyone chats warmly
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not speak decently or interestingly enough, I will be seen as awkward and be rejected
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeping Silence, smiling and nodding to lower one's presence, trying not to join conversations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will find me awkward; I will say stupid things

special_situations.event: Before preparing to speak up and join conversation in group settings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make a fool of myself as soon as I open my mouth, others will not like me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Choosing in advance not to speak or to leave the situation, reducing risk through avoidance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will make mistakes and be embarrassed as soon as I speak

special_situations.event: Seeing scenes of others socializing and making friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not have friends like others do, it means I am no good and not worthy of being liked
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding staying in such situations, with inner Self-denial
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone has friends; I have nothing / I am not as good as them

special_situations.event: When considering talking to Mother about one's Social anxiety
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express vulnerability, the other person will not understand me and will only make me more embarrassed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Hesitates and reduces communication on such topics to avoid possible misunderstanding

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and build close, natural friendships
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected and humiliation, being seen by others as clumsy and awkward
defense_goal: Maintaining a sense of safety through Withdrawal and avoidance, avoiding self-exposure to reduce the risk of being negated and shamed

object_relations.object_representation: Picky others who judge and do not like oneself
A Mother unable to understand one's feelings

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: In Social situations when others chat and laugh, but have not yet interacted with or invited oneself directly
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others will notice one's awkwardness and judge oneself (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Keep a cautious tone, use vague expressions (e.g. 'they might...'), reduce self-disclosure, choose Silence or brief responses.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to discuss Social anxiety with Mother and try to gain support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equating possible misunderstanding with inevitable rejection, believing expression only brings negation
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Citing various practical difficulties as reasons (e.g. 'she will not understand me'), hesitant tone, lowering commitment to action.

manifestations: Self-reported having no friends, long-term Sense of isolation since High school
Seeing others socialize intensifies Loneliness and Self-denial
outcomes: Persistent Loneliness and sense of isolation
Decreased daily drive, impaired sense of well-being

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: In sessions, repeatedly expresses worrying about 'saying something stupid' and being seen embarrassed
Describing minimizing one's presence in social settings, being so cautious as not to join conversations

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Assuming in sessions that 'others will not like me''she (Mother) will not understand me'
Attributing inner negated experiences to others' possible attitudes

positive_force: Has a supportive Mother (can communicate on practical matters)
Has clear career goals (aspires to become a Veterinarian)
Once actively tried starting conversations, willing to change the status quo
negative_force: Significant Social anxiety, prone to freezing in groups
Cognitive distortions: mind reading, predicting negative outcomes, comparing with others / overgeneralization
Habitually Avoids socializing situations, keeping Silence
Self-labeling as 'I cannot talk to anyone', lacking confidence

target_behavior.behavior: Avoidance and Silence in Social situations (minimizing presence, not actively participating)
antecedent: Being in a group or gathering
When needing to start a conversation or respond to others
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic Anticipation of negative evaluation and embarrassment plus mind-reading guesses (fearing 'saying something stupid''being seen as awkward') triggering Anxiety, which in turn prompts Withdrawal
target_behavior.function: Escaping unwelcome emotions (Anxiety, shame) and avoiding possible negative evaluation
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent isolation and sense of Loneliness, decreased daily drive, affected interpersonal and career goals (the social communication needed to become a Veterinarian)
